profile.headline: Principal Software Development Engineer - DevOps
profile.summary: Ambitious | Personable | Trustworthy | Curious | Enthusiastic | Hard Working

positions.title: Software Development Intern
positions.description: Designed and implemented a network switch management interface using JQuery, JQuery Mobile, JavaScript, Html and CSS so that customers could manage device settings easily through their phones/tablets.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: An open source android application (java) which brings crowdsourcing to the plug-in electric car user. Public data of charging stations is incomplete, using this app the community could add existing stations, comment/rate stations, and suggest stations to be built.  (http://goo.gl/hua6cw)

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Designed and implemented (in C/C++) a network of microcontrollers to communicate serially with measuring end devices such as pH meters, refractometers, chroma meters, weight scales and a database. These micro controllers also communicated with each other and users to create a data repository in an SD card. (http://goo.gl/KTYTji)
